jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Intern, Summer 2027
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Helix AI builds foundation models for industrial forecasting. Our 12-week Summer 2027 research internship (June to September) pairs you with a research mentor.

  • Train and evaluate PyTorch models on time series data
  • Run experiments and write up results

You study engineering, mathematics or computer science and know Python and machine learning fundamentals.
